findings.summary: the public enquiry write is not gated, and the guest holds a reference the venue cannot see
findings.detail: F-EV-INQUIRY-UNGATED, open for a product ruling. POST /events/inquiries carries no store-scoped Events.Core gate, so this walk created event eef25e72-366a-5dfe-60aa-f801f5275323 for store 42 while every admin read for that store answered 404 EVENTS_DISABLED. The guest was told to keep a reference for a booking nobody at the venue can open. This journey asserts what is true rather than the gate a ruling might add.
